There is API to change bitrate and codec(to h265), however stuck the camera while recording:

> t app test chg_bitrate c [bitrate]

> t app test chg_bitrate [avg_bitrate][min_ratio][max_ratio]

> Usage: t app test record <option>
    Test option list:
	 show
	 dual  [0 | 1] 
	 duals [0 | 1] 
	 enctype [streamId][encodeType] 
	     streamId:   0 -> primary, 1: secondary 
	     encodeType: 0 -> H264,    1: H265

dmesg won't show you anything relevant because the bitrate stuff is all done in the RTOS, not on the linux.

Try using the RTOS ps command if it exists on the yi4k+.

From that PS output (STKBASE) I see you have 2 memory offsets, 0x00000000 and 0x50000000.

If I compare with the output I had from my yi4k I think that you should try dumping the memory at: 0x00000000 and see if the bitrate table is somewhere in there.

To find it just look for 00 00 70 42 and you should be able to find it easily if it's there.
